lobby.connectWalletStart: Connect your wallet to start raiding

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Sol Raid is an on-chain extraction game on Solana. You enter with a stake, choose your difficulty, and try to score as many points as possible before getting busted. Cash out at the right moment to convert your score into SOL. The longer you hold, the higher the reward — but risk rises every second.
faq.q2: What is the difference between a normal raid and a round-based raid?
faq.a2: Normal raids pay out SOL immediately when you succeed — your reward is based on your score and entry fee. Round-based raids score points instead of paying instant SOL. Your best score in a 6-hour window competes on the round leaderboard, and prizes are claimed after the round ends.
faq.a3: There are 4 rounds per day (UTC), each lasting 6 hours. Your highest score in a round goes on the leaderboard. After the round closes, 8% of all entry fees from that window are split among the top 5 wallets by score: 1st 40% · 2nd 25% · 3rd 18% · 4th 11% · 5th 6%.
faq.q4: How do I claim my round winnings?
faq.a4: After a round closes, go to Profile → Round Wins tab. Eligible rounds show a Claim button. Claiming credits SOL to your unclaimed balance — then use the Withdraw button to send it on-chain to your wallet.
faq.a5: Yes. Before each raid a SHA-256 server seed hash is committed. After the raid the full seed is revealed so you can verify the RNG was never manipulated. Seed history is visible in your profile.
faq.a6: Base win rate is roughly 25–30% with no gear. Gear and boosts can push this toward 45%. The house margin comes from risk drift mechanics — the longer you stay, the harder it gets.
faq.a7: Raid Passes give 50% off the entry fee plus a 10% boost to your SOL winnings. You earn 1 free ticket per day (max 3 stockpiled). Additional passes are purchased with SKR in the Store. Toggle the ticket at deployment if you own one.
faq.a8: SKR (Seeker) is the in-game utility token on Solana. It is used to buy Raid Passes, gear, and avatars in the Store. SKR is also accepted as payment for raid entry fees alongside SOL and USDC.
faq.a9: PvP lets you stake against other players in a shared room. All players raid the same RNG seed simultaneously — pure skill decides the outcome. The player with the highest score when they extract wins the full pot. Stake any amount in SOL, USDC, or SKR.
